headline: Verified premium sprite restoration: original artwork, no bleed or cropped edges

changes.title: All twenty premium economy icons restored from original art
changes.detail: Re-extracted the exact matching shop and economy icon identities, including the purple Booster Crate bar, Lifetime VIP shield, Royal Squirrel gift, red chest and hourglass. Each transparent PNG has preserved margins and a pinned hash.

changes.title: Twenty-one original user-interface icons restored
changes.detail: Re-exported the original menu, shop, coupon-related, timer and navigation icons from their source atlas with whole-object alpha isolation. Images retain their existing names and button wiring; the nut sprites were not altered.

changes.title: Immutable source atlases and verified recovery bundles archived
changes.detail: Committed untouched owner originals plus separate per-item QA recovery archives and an integrity test. Remaining complex power-up and effects originals are preserved without overwriting playable assets until their glow boundaries are reviewed.
